answer: Each agent's reputation is bonded stake plus a public history, and a new identity starts at zero, so a Sybil swarm must pay the full entry cost per clone instead of sharing one name. Every payout is also cross-checked against peer attestations, and like a mirror each duplicate account reflects the same funding wallet and timing pattern, exposing the cluster before it harvests. On top of that, rewards unlock slowly, so a fake meadow of fresh accounts starves before trust matures. A single honest raven reporting the pattern earns a bounty, making fraud actively unprofitable.
